Hi Elaine —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our demo and the main items we wanted to confirm on the security/compliance side: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is in an ongoing Type II cycle; we can share a redacted SOC 2 report or an attestation letter under NDA.
- HIPAA/BAA: We support HIPAA-covered workflows. For Private/Dedicated deployments we can execute a BAA; for Hosted customers we have standard controls and a BAA path (let us know if you require dedicated tenancy).
- Encryption (at-rest/in-transit): All customer data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest by default.
- Key management options: 
  * Redwood-managed KMS (default): we manage CMKs and rotation.
  * Customer-managed keys (BYOK): bring-your-own-key via cloud KMS import or HSM-backed keys (AWS KMS CMKs with external key material or CloudHSM integration).
  * On-prem / private HSM integration: available for Private deployments; we support HSMs that meet FIPS 140-2/3 in relevant configurations.
- Operational controls: key rotation policies, split knowledge access for key material, and audit logging for all key operations.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Ill send our short vendor security questionnaire stub and a brief BYOK spec (attached).
2) Can you confirm whether NorthRidge needs a customer-held HSM (hardware) or if cloud-KMS with imported key material is sufficient?
3) If you want a SOC 2 artifact now, please sign the attached NDA (or confirm you can receive a redacted report) and well route it to security@northridge-health.com.
4) Schedule a 30-minute technical follow-up with Marissa (security) + Aditya (solutions).

Attached: Redwood_CMK_BYO_Spec.pdf, Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_stub.pdf

Thanks — happy to align calendar times.

Best,

Kimberly Park

Thanks Elaine — wanted to respond to each of your bullets and propose a short mutual action plan.

On HIPAA / BAA:
- Short answer: yes, we execute BAAs. For Hosted we have a standard BAA; for extra isolation (and some customers) we recommend Dedicated or Private where you can control tenancy and network boundaries.

On customer-held keys / HSM:
- We support multiple models: cloud KMS CMK import (you can provide external key material), managed CloudHSM integration, and Private deployments that connect to an on-prem HSM via a secure tunnel. If NorthRidge requires an on-prem HSM that never leaves your environment, we can architect a Private deployment that keeps key material on your HSM.
- We support FIPS-validated HSM modules; Marissa will follow up with supported module/cert numbers.

On SOC 2 artifacts:
- We can provide a redacted SOC 2 Type II report or an attestation letter. For full reports we generally require an NDA; if youd like a redacted version we can share that to security@northridge-health.com immediately.

Proposed mutual action plan: 
1) NorthRidge completes the attached Vendor_Security_Questionnaire and sends to security@northridge-health.com (Ive attached a stub).
2) We provide a redacted SOC 2 attestation to security@northridge-health.com by EOD Monday after an agreement to the redaction scope.
3) Schedule a technical deep-dive (30–45 min) on Tue 12/8 to walk through BYOK import flow, HSM options, and deployment models. Suggested slots: 11:00 PST / 14:00 EST or 13:00 PST / 16:00 EST.
4) If Private/on-prem is required, Marissa will produce an initial security design and Aditya will scope the implementation effort and high-level cost.

Attachments: SOC2_access_instructions.txt (how we handle redacted reports and NDA process)

Looping in Marissa and Aditya to pick the SOC/HSM bits and lock the Tue slot if that works.

Best,

Kim
